author: stahlleiton
body:
#### PR description:

This PR extends the maximum dZ error and |eta| to 3 used in the track selection for the primary vertex reconstruction in OO UPC reco, to improve PV reco efficiency for coherent phi meson reconstruction.

#### PR validation:

Tested with relvals 143.911,143.912

title: Optimize PV for OO UPC reco
